title: Bandit Technique Map
scope: Conceptual map from bandit/RL settings and objectives to the proof/algorithmic techniques that materially change the analysis. These relations are teaching/research overlays, not Lean theorem dependencies.

techniques.title: Confidence sets → optimism → regret
techniques.mechanism: Construct a high-probability confidence object, choose an optimistic action/value, and charge instantaneous regret to confidence width before summing widths.

techniques.title: Elimination / sequential testing
techniques.mechanism: Maintain confidence sets, eliminate implausible arms/hypotheses, and convert fixed-confidence testing error into sample-complexity bounds.

techniques.title: Posterior sampling / probability matching
techniques.mechanism: Sample from a posterior or posterior-induced optimal-action law instead of constructing an explicit optimistic index.

techniques.title: Robust estimation / truncation / robust confidence
techniques.mechanism: Replace sub-Gaussian sample means by estimators or confidence sequences that survive heavy tails, contamination, censoring, or heterogeneous variance.

techniques.title: Second-order / empirical-Bernstein control
techniques.mechanism: Use observed or intrinsic variance/second-moment information so regret scales with variance-like quantities rather than only ranges or worst-case proxies.

techniques.title: Exponential weights / FTRL / mirror descent
techniques.mechanism: Telescope a regularized potential while controlling bandit estimators and stability, producing comparator regret under adversarial feedback.

techniques.title: Zooming / metric localization
techniques.mechanism: Localize exploration to near-optimal regions of a metric action space; covering/packing or near-optimality dimension replaces ambient cardinality.

techniques.title: RKHS confidence / information gain
techniques.mechanism: Control nonparametric uncertainty through RKHS geometry, posterior/kernel variance, and information-gain or effective-dimension quantities.

techniques.title: Bandit convex smoothing / gradient estimation
techniques.mechanism: Smooth a convex loss and build a one- or multi-point gradient estimator from bandit feedback, then apply convex optimization regret machinery.

techniques.title: Combinatorial oracle / relaxation / semi-bandit estimation
techniques.mechanism: Separate statistical learning from a combinatorial optimization oracle or relaxation; exploit coordinate/semi-bandit observations when available.

techniques.title: Primal–dual / Lagrangian resource control
techniques.mechanism: Introduce dual prices or feasibility certificates so reward optimization and cumulative resource/safety constraints are controlled together.

techniques.title: Causal intervention / observational transfer
techniques.mechanism: Use a structural causal model to transfer information across interventions or combine observational and interventional data.

techniques.title: Feedback-graph / partial-monitoring information structure
techniques.mechanism: Exploit which actions reveal information about which other actions; graph observability or feedback partitions determine the regret regime.

techniques.title: Pairwise preference / dueling reductions
techniques.mechanism: Replace scalar reward observations by comparisons and analyze preference matrices, Condorcet/Borda structure, or reductions to ordinary bandits.

techniques.title: Low-dimensional / sparse / factorized structure
techniques.mechanism: Exploit linear, sparse, low-rank, tensor, factorized, unimodal, or parametric structure so confidence and exploration depend on intrinsic rather than ambient complexity.

techniques.title: Change detection / windows / variation-budget adaptation
techniques.mechanism: Forget, restart, window, discount, or meta-combine learners so regret adapts to switches, drift, variation, delayed feedback, or changing arm availability.

techniques.title: Corralling / model-selection meta-learning
techniques.mechanism: Run several base learners or model classes under a master algorithm and pay only the unavoidable adaptation overhead.

techniques.title: Distributed coordination / communication / collision control
techniques.mechanism: Coordinate exploration across agents while accounting for communication, collisions, heterogeneity, decentralization, or strategic interaction.

techniques.title: Privacy accounting / randomized perturbation
techniques.mechanism: Inject and account for privacy-preserving noise while maintaining confidence or regret guarantees under central/local/joint privacy semantics.

techniques.title: Scalarization / Pareto / multi-objective selection
techniques.mechanism: Replace one scalar reward with a vector criterion and use scalarization, Pareto identification, or preference-dependent selection without collapsing objectives silently.

techniques.title: Coverage / concentrability / pessimism
techniques.mechanism: Replace online exploration by assumptions on dataset coverage or concentrability and use pessimistic value estimation to avoid unsupported actions.

techniques.title: Belief-state / memory representation
techniques.mechanism: Replace fully observed states by information states, beliefs, finite memory, or predictive representations before planning/learning.

techniques.title: Bellman recursion + optimistic bonuses
techniques.mechanism: Propagate statistical uncertainty through Bellman recursion and control cumulative episodic regret via occupancy/bonus decompositions.

techniques.title: Preference / routing / allocation reductions for LLM systems
techniques.mechanism: Map an LLM-system decision problem—preference selection, model routing, evaluation, or inference-time allocation—to an explicit bandit/RL feedback and objective contract before applying theory.

techniques.title: Quantum mean estimation / quantum testing / quantum design
techniques.mechanism: Exploit coherent quantum reward-oracle access for faster mean estimation, and use quantum hypothesis-testing/polynomial-method lower bounds to characterize the new regret scale.
